parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The security group ID
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The security group rule ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679845.html to query security group rule IDs
parameters.help_zh: 安全组规则ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679845.html 查询安全组规则ID
parameters.name: security_group_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The access permissions. Valid values: 
         
- accept: Accepts access.
- drop: Denies access without returning a deny response.

Default value: accept
parameters.help_zh:
访问权限。取值范围： 
         
- accept：接受访问。
- drop：拒绝访问，不返回拒绝信息。

默认值：accept
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the security group rule. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
安全组规则优先级。取值范围：1~100。

默认值：1
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The network layer or transport layer protocol. Two types of values are supported:
1. Case-insensitive protocol names. Valid values:
- ICMP
- GRE
- TCP
- UDP
- ALL: All protocols are supported.
2. Protocol numbers that comply with IANA specifications, which are integers from 0 to 255. The following regions currently support this feature:
- Philippines
- UK (London)
- Malaysia
- China (Hohhot)
- China (Qingdao)
- US (Virginia)
- Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
网络层/传输层协议。支持两类赋值：
1. 不区分大小写的协议名。取值范围：
- ICMP
- GRE
- TCP
- UDP
- ALL：支持所有协议。
2. 符合IANA规范的协议号取值，即0 到 255的整数。目前开放的地域列表：
- 菲律宾
- 英国
- 马来西亚
- 呼和浩特
- 青岛
- 美西
- 新加坡
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the source IPv4 CIDR block for the access permissions. Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) format and IPv4 format IP address range are supported.

Default value: null
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址块。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。

默认值：无
parameters.name: source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the source IPv6 CIDR block for the access permissions. Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) format and IPv6 format IP address range are supported.

> Only VPC-type IP addresses are supported. This parameter and `SourceCidrIp` cannot be specified at the same time.

Default value: null
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问权限的源端IPv6 CIDR地址块。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。

> 仅支持VPC类型的IP地址，且该参数与`SourceCidrIp`参数不可同时设置。

默认值：无
parameters.name: ipv6_source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the ID of the source security group for the access permissions. Specify at least one of `SourceGroupId` and `SourceCidrIp`.

- If `SourceGroupId` is specified but `SourceCidrIp` is not, the `NicType` parameter can only be set to intranet.
- If both `SourceGroupId` and `SourceCidrIp` are specified, `SourceCidrIp` takes precedence by default
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问权限的源端安全组ID。至少设置一项`SourceGroupId`或者`SourceCidrIp`参数。

- 如果指定了`SourceGroupId`没有指定参数`SourceCidrIp`，则参数`NicType`取值只能为intranet。
- 如果同时指定了`SourceGroupId`和`SourceCidrIp`，则默认以`SourceCidrIp`为准
parameters.name: source_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the ID of the source prefix list for the access permissions. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205046.html to query available prefix list IDs.

This parameter is ignored if you specify one of the `SourceCidrIp`, `Ipv6SourceCidrIp`, or `SourceGroupId` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问权限的源端前缀列表ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205046.html查询可以使用的前缀列表ID。

当您指定了`SourceCidrIp`、`Ipv6SourceCidrIp`或`SourceGroupId`参数中的一个时，将忽略该参数
parameters.name: source_prefix_list_id

parameters.help_en:
The range of destination ports for the transport layer protocol. Valid values: 
         
- TCP/UDP: Valid values are 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and the end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
- ICMP: -1/-1.
- GRE: -1/-1.
- ALL: -1/-1
parameters.help_zh:
目的端安全组开放的传输层协议相关的端口范围。取值范围： 
         
- TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
- ICMP协议：-1/-1。
- GRE协议：-1/-1。
- ALL：-1/-1
parameters.name: port_range

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the source security group when you configure access permissions for a cross-account security group rule. 
         
- If neither `SourceGroupOwnerAccount` nor `SourceGroupOwnerID` is specified, the rule is configured for access permissions of another security group that you own.
- If the `SourceCidrIp` parameter is specified, the `SourceGroupOwnerAccount` parameter is ignored

跨账户设置安全组规则时，源端安全组所属的阿里云账户。

- 如果已经设置参数`SourceCidrIp`，则参数`SourceGroupOwnerAccount`无效
